summary: Plan site-fit agroforestry, establishment and monitoring. Develop field-ready restoration outputs. Explore the five-day intermediate course.
lede: Agroforestry training covers how trees can be integrated with crops or livestock and how restoration activities are planned and monitored. It is for intermediate agroforestry, restoration and extension practitioners who need to assess sites and develop interventions with land users. Participants practise mapping stakeholders, selecting and designing suitable systems, planning planting and maintenance, and recording baseline and repeat indicators with FERM and TAPE.
audienceIntro: This intermediate course is designed for practitioners who assess land, plan agroforestry interventions, coordinate establishment and review restoration progress with land users and other stakeholders.
prerequisites: Prior practical exposure to planning, establishing or managing agroforestry or land restoration interventions is expected. No coding or programming is required.
